title: Bolívar and San Martín: two armies, one aim
goal: I can describe the campaigns of Bolívar and San Martín and say what is known about their meeting.
grammar: The gerund: actions that happen together

items: I can say how San Martín crossed the Andes and which battle the patriots won.
I can say where San Martín and Bolívar came from and where their armies advanced.
I can name some key battles and years of the campaigns.
I can say what is known, and not known, about the meeting in Guayaquil.
I can say how the war ended in South America.
I can use the gerund to say how or while something happened.
